name: SPI Semicon
old_description: At SPI/Semicon, we manufacture semiconductor packaging solutions as advanced as the wafers they protect.
about:
SPI Semicon, headquartered in Ogden, Utah, traces its roots to 1970. The company was formed through the merger of two industry leaders, Semicon Systems and Semiconductor Products, combining decades of expertise in semiconductor packaging.

The company specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging, spanning front-end wafer fabrication to back-end finished devices. Its manufacturing processes include injection molding, vacuum forming, die-cutting, extrusion, and custom-made parts. Operations are supported by state-of-the-art facilities in the United States and the Philippines.

SPI Semicon serves the semiconductor industry, providing packaging solutions and components that meet or exceed EIA-541 and ESD 5.11.1 standards for resistivity and static protection. Its customer base includes semiconductor manufacturers requiring high-reliability packaging for advanced wafers and devices.

The company emphasizes innovation, quality, and exceptional service as its differentiators, backed by an ISO 9001 certified quality management system. Its unique product designs and unmatched packaging options are engineered to exceed the highest industry standards, reflecting a commitment to precision and reliability that powers technology worldwide.
